description.value: Well-maintained private RV park just outside Salmon Arm on the Trans-Canada, set among pines and cedars with mountains and Shuswap Lake nearby; good amenities including free showers and WiFi, though it is primarily RV-focused with only a single grassy tent area at $40/night.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and provides detailed amenity information. The site confirms free solar-heated showers for all guests, coin-operated laundry, free sitewide WiFi, a new water treatment system, tent camping, and online reservations for 2026. A minor name discrepancy exists between OSM ('and') and the website ('&'), and no phone number appears in OSM tags though the website prominently lists 778 489 1196.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'ViewPoint RV Park and Cottages' but website consistently uses 'ViewPoint RV Park & Cottages' (ampersand vs. 'and').
No phone number in OSM tags; website prominently lists 778 489 1196.
Tent camping is available but no explicit hiker/biker walk-in rate or cyclist-specific accommodation is mentioned.
Street address number (6871) not explicitly confirmed by website content — only Trans-Canada Highway location near Salmon Arm is stated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate seasonal campground with tent sites, free showers, laundry, WiFi, and potable water on the Trans-Canada Highway near Salmon Arm — a solid stopover for touring cyclists in the Shuswap.
enrichment_extras.notes: Park operates approximately April to mid-October depending on weather. Wheelchair-accessible washroom and shower confirmed on amenities page.

wow_evidence: free solar-heated showers for all guests, coin-operated laundry, free sitewide WiFi
